messages:
Jamal: FYI planning MapleVista private rollout for their Dedicated slice next Wed 03/29 02:00 UTC. Need: cutover window approval, version pin, canary schedule, and rollback thresholds.
Maria: +1 on the window. Is that during our low-traffic maintenance window?
Jamal: yes, aligns with our standard 02:00 UTC low-traffic window. I checked tenant traffic—95thpct under commit.
Alex: Model and runtime note: we'll pin to runtime v2.7.1 + model rmi-v1.4-quant. That combo passed perf tests.
Maria: Can we confirm KV cache warmup plan? Last time cold starts spiked latency.
Alex: plan: pre-warm 2 pods with warmup script 45m prior, then add remaining replicas at T-10m. Script: ```bash
# warmup
curl -X POST $ENDPOINT -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"warmup"}'
```
SRE Ops: @Jamal please add the runbook link and SLAs. We'll need PagerDuty on-call for the window.
Jamal: done. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maplevista-cutover (note: internal link). PD: rota is set to oncall-sre.
deploy-bot: Scheduling deploy for thread 2175002468. Planned start: 2026-03-29T02:00:00Z. Canary slices: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m bake intervals. Command: `/deploy schedule --tenant maplevista --image rmi-v1.4-quant --runtime v2.7.1 --start 2026-03-29T02:00:00Z --canary 5,25,100 --bake 10m`
Priya: Release notes posted: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/maplevista-2026-03-29. Includes KMS key rotation steps.
Maria: Any data plane changes that require firewall/VPC updates? MapleVista uses private VPC peering.
Alex: No infra changes. Just model/runtime swap and traffic shift. No port changes.
SRE Ops: Rollback thresholds proposal: if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR latency P95 increases > 150ms compared to baseline, abort and roll back to rmi-v1.3. Agreed?
Maria: Agree. Add quality gate: decode error rate > 0.1% -> rollback.
Jamal: adding to runbook. Also pinning versions in customer config: `model: rmi-v1.4-quant`, `runtime: v2.7.1`, `fallback: rmi-v1.3`.
Priya: Compliance note: client requires audit log retention 1y. Confirming console has retention set.
Alex: console retention already 14 months for that tenant.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 completed (5%). No errors.
deploy-bot: Canary step 2 completed (25%). Observability: 5xx=0.03%, p95 +20ms.
SRE Ops: watching metrics. PD on-call standing by.
Maria: QA run: no regressions on prompt set A / prompt set B. Spot-check samples look good.
Jamal: final approval? React with :white_check_mark: and I'll kick full shift at T+20m.
Priya: :white_check_mark: (from Product)
Alex: :white_check_mark: (runtime)
SRE Ops: :white_check_mark: (ops)
Jamal: kicking full traffic shift now. Deploy log: ```
[02:22Z] traffic shift: 100% -> success
[02:23Z] post-cutover checks: metrics stable
```
deploy-bot: Deploy finished for thread 2175002468. All canaries passed.
Maria: noted: will monitor quality dashboard for next 24h. If any alerts, we'll roll back per runbook.
Jamal: thanks team. Closing thread after 24h no-alerts. :)
SRE Ops: added post-mortem checklist item to verify cache hit rates 24h post-cutover.
Priya: I'll send release email to customer and CS with rollback contact info.
Jamal: closing in T-24h unless we get signals. :rocket:
